SECTION 1. Capitalized Terms . Capitalized terms used and not defined herein shall have such meanings ascribed thereto in the Credit Agreement. The rules of construction set forth in Section 1.03 of the Credit Agreement shall apply to this Agreement, mutatis mutandis.

“ provided further that the Company shall not so designate any such letter of credit if, after giving effect thereto (and any substantially concurrent termination, amendment or other modification to any other Designated Performance Letter of Credit), the aggregate face amount of all such letters of credit shall exceed US$175,000,000.”

## CRANE NXT, CO. - THIRD AMENDMENT TO CREDIT AGREEMENT

---

## 1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

**Date of Agreement:** July 3, 2025

**Borrower/Company Overview:** Crane NXT, Co., a Delaware corporation

**Transaction Description:** Third Amendment to an existing Credit Agreement originally dated March 17, 2023. The transaction involves Crane NXT, Co. as borrower, with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. serving as Administrative Agent, and various lenders party to the original credit facility.

**Purpose of Financing:** The amendment specifically increases the limit for Designated Performance Letters of Credit from an unspecified previous amount to US$175,000,000. This represents an expansion of the company's letter of credit capacity under the existing credit facility.

**Company Background and Context:** Crane NXT, Co. operates under an existing credit facility that has been previously amended twice (February 29, 2024 and December 9, 2024). The company appears to require enhanced letter of credit capacity, likely to support performance guarantees related to its business operations.

---

## 2. INVESTMENT HIGHLIGHTS & RISKS

### Key Strengths / Credit Positives:
• **Established Banking Relationship** - Maintains ongoing relationship with JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. as Administrative Agent
• **Incremental Enhancement** - Amendment represents a limited, specific modification rather than comprehensive restructuring
• **Lender Support** - Required Lenders have agreed to the amendment terms
• **Legal Compliance** - Company represents it has proper corporate authorization for the amendment

### Principal Risks and Mitigating Factors:
• **Limited Financial Information** - Amendment provides minimal insight into company's current financial condition or performance
• **Increased Contingent Exposure** - Higher letter of credit limit (US$175,000,000) increases potential contingent liabilities
• **Multiple Amendments** - This represents the third amendment in approximately two years, suggesting ongoing need for facility modifications
• **Performance Letter of Credit Risk** - Increased capacity specifically for performance letters of credit may indicate expansion into higher-risk project-based business
